column1: > Figure registry for the NAR 2026 update paper. One row per FIGURE SET: the
> output directory under latex/figures/, the script, the exact argv, and tags.
> Scoped to Papers/NAR_Update_2026/ rather than the ModelSEEDDatabase repo root,
> because the repo root already has a `Scripts/` (capital S) tree for the
> biochemistry pipeline and a second lowercase `scripts/` there would collide on
> case-insensitive checkouts. Paper figures are a separate concern anyway.
> Adding a new figure: add a row here in the same call that creates the script.
> An unregistered figure is a figure nobody can regenerate.
